versions.changelog:
- Expanded and restructured documentation for improved clarity and usability.
- Added detailed examples for searching, saving, organizing, and exporting both Reader documents and Readwise highlights.
- Clarified command syntax, parameters, and available options throughout.
- Included common workflows and step-by-step usage scenarios.
- Provided additional guidance on Reader locations, metadata, and best practices for bulk editing.
- Improved tips for efficient filtering and exporting data.

Initial release of the readwise-official skill.

- Access your Readwise highlights and Reader documents via the command line.
- Search, read, organize, and manage your entire reading library using `readwise` CLI commands.
- Supports highlights, daily review, spaced repetition, and Reader document management.
- Includes setup instructions for installation and authentication.
- Detailed usage examples for searching, reading, saving, organizing content, and daily review.
- Productivity category; requires the Readwise CLI to be installed.
